definitions.gloss: sense of values, values, value system
definitions.explanation: One's set of beliefs about what is important in life. Used to describe personal, cultural, or generational perspectives on what matters.

examples.japanese: {価値観|かちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{価値観|かちかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Old values no longer hold up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{価値観|かちかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Values differ greatly depending on the generation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧ (value) + {観|かん} (view/perspective). Refers to one's personal belief system about what matters in life — priorities, morals, and what one considers important.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {価値観|かちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to have different values
- {価値観|かちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to share the same values
- {価値観|かちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: values change
- {価値観|かちかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多様化|たようか}→多様化：07564_tayouka⟧: diversification of values
- {価値観|かちかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{付|つ}ける→押し付ける：04236_oshitsukeru⟧: to impose one's values on others

USAGE:
Frequently appears in discussions about relationships ({価値観|かちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ is considered important for marriage), generational differences, and cultural change. A common topic in Japanese media and conversation.
